= Kafka Streams Control Panel

The Kafka Streams Control Panel provides a visual representation of your Kafka Streams topologies:

Features include:

* Visualize the stream processing topology using Mermaid diagrams.
* View the number of sub-topologies as a badge.
* Automatically generated from the configured `ConfiguredStreamBuilder` beans.

To get started, add the following module as a development-time dependency:

dependency:io.micronaut.controlpanel:micronaut-control-panel-kafka[scope=developmentOnly]

It is assumed that you already have Kafka Streams configured in your application. If not, you can check the following documentation:

* https://micronaut-projects.github.io/micronaut-kafka/latest/guide/#kafkaStreams[Micronaut Kafka Streams Documentation]
* https://guides.micronaut.io/latest/tag-kafka.html[Kafka Guides]

=== Configuration

The Kafka Streams control panel is automatically enabled when you include the `micronaut-control-panel-kafka` module in your project.
You can disable it by setting:

[configuration]
----
micronaut:
  control-panel:
    kafka-streams:
      enabled: false
----
